San Francisco Rent Ordinance: This rental unit is subject to the San Francisco Rent Ordinance, which provides tenants with significant protections. This ordinance limits evictions to specific "just causes" and prohibits landlords from demanding excessive rent increases. Additionally, the Rent Ordinance states that any attempt by a tenant to waive their rights under the ordinance is considered invalid and unenforceable. This ensures that tenants are aware of and can fully exercise their rights under the law.
